articles.title: Free Food, First Aid, Sanitary Pads: What's Keeping the CJP Protest Going | Jantar Mantar
articles.description: As the CJP-led protest over alleged NEET irregularities continues at Delhi's Jantar Mantar, support for the student protesters is coming in many forms. People from across the country are sending meals through food delivery apps, while volunteers have set up makeshift counters to distribute food, water and other essentials free of cost. Beyond food, first-aid stations stocked with antiseptics, ORS, bandages, sanitary pads and other medical supplies are assisting those in need. Volunteers are also cleaning the protest site and distributing drinking water, including to security personnel, highlighting the community-led efforts that have become an integral part of the ongoing demonstration.
